findings.detail: Shared stop currently covers rate/unknown/persistence only. Known-cost missing source/native-export infrastructure errors and generic orchestration setup failures can proceed into the next arm. Propagate explicit infrastructure classification and stop subsequent dispatch/arms without treating ordinary semantic model-selection outcomes as infrastructure.

positive_checks: Actual local Git plus bounded native recycler/export integration passes both eager/demand arms.
Factory callback checks shared health/storage after secret resolution; native episode admission callback also checks health.
Successful persisted trajectory result is reused by hash rather than duplicated; evaluator execution remains excluded.
